text:
maya_support: FYI — customer reported promo code 'WELCOME2026' rejected as expired when applying during checkout. They pasted error: `promo_code_invalid`.
lex_support: thx. can you paste the exact API response and the account email? any screenshots?
maya_support: customer attached screenshot and request id 3f8a2c. email: user@example.com (redacted). API response: `{"error":"promo_code_invalid","message":"Code expired or invalid"}`
lex_support: ok. checking promo service logs... @promo_bot can you fetch promo lookup for code WELCOME2026?
promo_bot: pulled promo record WELCOME2026 -> status: inactive, expiry_ts: 1709490000, created_by: partner_onboarding, redemptions: 0
lex_support: looks expired at DB level (expiry 2024-04-02). but customer says it was sent this week.
rich_eng: jumping in — can you share request headers + region? sometimes signature mismatch or partner UI timezone causes bad expiry.
maya_support: request id 3f8a2c, region: us-west-2. headers: `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***`, `X-Client-Version: web-1.4.3`.
rich_eng: running quick repro against staging with same code...
rich_eng: repro steps:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \ 
  -d '{"code":"WELCOME2026","email":"user@example.com"}'
```
rich_eng: response: `{"error":"promo_code_invalid","reason":"expired"}`
rich_eng: DB shows expiry_ts is 1709490000 (Apr 2 2024). Looks like partner created a promo with wrong expiry date (past-dated).
sam_billing: i can issue manual credit. how much should we grant?
maya_support: customer requested a 30-day trial equivalent to $50. they signed up yesterday.
sam_billing: i'll push $50 credit to account user@example.com and reissue a new code with correct expiry. posting transaction id TX-987654.
sam_billing: manual credit applied, reissued code: WELCOME2026-RE (expires 2026-12-31). sent via support email.
maya_support: passed reissue to customer, asked them to try again, flagged for follow-up.
customer_bot: customer confirmed they redeemed new code successfully — they said "thanks!"
lex_support: closing loop — rich, can we add a quick validation in partner onboarding to prevent past-dated expiry? also log the partner UI timezone.
rich_eng: noted. filing issue INF-4521. will add server-side validation + UI warning, and a small telemetry metric to catch partner-created promos with expiry < now. ETA next sprint.
lex_support: thanks everyone. leaving thread open for 24h to confirm no further regressions.
sam_billing: marked as credited in billing ledger (TX-987654).
maya_support: customer reply at 2141595200: "New code worked, appreciate it." closing.
